messages:
zoe: quick note 1: preflight for engine-v2.15-quant failed a checksum verification in staging, but only for builds produced on the new build-farm worker `builder-42`.

priya: curious if builder-42 has different umask or tar flags. iirc we had a similar nondeterminism last year.

ben: deploybot preflight log snippet: ```WARN: artifact tarball contains duplicate path: ./lib/matmul_q4.so -> lib/matmul_q4.so. bundlestamp computed: 0x2a9f1b, observed: 0x3b8f2c on host staging-gpu-04```

zoe: plan: keep staging pinned to previous bundle and quarantined builder-42. file bug for CI to normalize tar creation and enforce deterministic ordering.

opsbot: staging pin applied: staging -> engine-v2.14 TTL 8h. Notifying ci-team.

priya: i'll run deterministic tar check across all builders and add a pre-commit hook that fails build if file ordering or repetition detected.

zoe: thanks. also add a short note in release notes: "Staging preflight detected nondeterministic packaging from builder-42; bundle quarantined while CI fixes ordering."

priya: filing CI-789: enforce `tar --sort=name --mtime=0 --owner=0 --group=0` in build script, and run check. ETA 35m.

ben: adding owners: ci=priya, ops=zoe. will unpin after CI confirms builder-42 fixed.

deploybot: action summary: staging pin, builder quarantined, CI ticket opened.
